1. blocker (line 254): U21 tests for the arrowhead size properties panel control, mixed multi-selection state, undo/redo history, and arrow-to-arrow style copy/paste are missing from `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.test.tsx` (leaving AC-4, AC-5, and AC-8 untested) because calling `UI.createElement("arrow")` with the default `size = 10` falls below `MINIMUM_ARROW_SIZE` and leaves `appState.multiElement` active, which blocks undo. — fix: Add the U21 test suite in `packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.test.tsx` before line 254, using `UI.createElement("arrow", { size: 100 })` so the arrow is finalized and recorded in history before calling `Keyboard.undo()` and `Keyboard.redo()`, and use `API.executeAction(actionCopyStyles)` / `API.executeAction(actionPasteStyles)` on arrows in `API.setElements` to verify copying and clearing `arrowheadSize`.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "packages/excalidraw/actions/actionProperties.test.tsx", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
